## Goal
See GP-09: banned words (docs/POSITIONING.md list) and 'available' channel claims vs release.yaml across README, USER_GUIDE, docs/user/*.md, distro/**/README.md. Allow quoted examples with an explicit marker. Start after WO-151/152 land.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New test file only (`test_cp_*.py`), offline, no new dependencies; real bugs → strict xfail with file:line reason, reported in VENDOR_STATUS.md. Never change `src/`.
- Run the new test and ruff on it and report real numbers (your shell may be refused; then say so, the owner reruns).
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/copilot/test_cp_wording_guard.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/, packaging/, every file not listed above.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md when done; Grace summarises in COPILOT_TO_CLAUDE.md.
